question: Can a 20-position, no-downsampling twin side field beat frozen raw d64 local retrieval or add precise top-32 supply on fresh organizer-train shuffles?

e13.distinction: E13 pooled each 4-pixel border into one 96-D vector; this model retains all 20 tangent positions through compatibility and exposes a full-tile 20x20 field plus raw skip.

seam_transformer.distinction: The seam Transformer scored shortlisted ordered pairs independently; this twin encoder embeds each tile once and compares every in-board candidate with factorized ordered sequences.

restored_border_ranker.distinction: The restored ranker consumed DRUNet pixels and a candidate union; this run trains from scratch on raw corrupted tiles and never predicts or consumes restored pixels.

fullres_boundary_denoiser.distinction: The prior no-pool network optimized clean RGB boundary reconstruction. This model has no RGB target or pixel head and optimizes directional adjacency plus corruption consistency only.

frozen_comparator.name: socket_d64_raw
frozen_comparator.scores: right_raw and down_raw before partial optimal transport

selection.evaluation_exclusions: frozen d64 recursive checkpoint ancestry plus every explicit existing eval/evaluation/local/confirm/decoder/terminal/selected/source panel filename; historical fit/train/library/pool declarations are not treated as exact-evaluation panels

architecture.tile_input: raw RGB plus per-tile/channel standardized RGB
architecture.field: 20x20x48, four depthwise-separable residual blocks, stride1 only, no pooling/resampling
architecture.side_sequence: four ordered length-20 sequences, two tangent-axis residual blocks
architecture.compatibility: mean corresponding-position cosine across all 20 tokens with learned horizontal/vertical temperature
architecture.raw_skip: fixed gain 0.35 times direction-specific raw/standardized 6-to-48 projection added before token normalization

training.corruptions: two independently seeded legal organizer-style per-tile brightness/contrast/noise/blur/JPEG corruptions sharing one exact shuffle
training.objective: within-view and cross-view four-direction full-board InfoNCE/listwise CE plus 0.25 hardest-negative margin and 0.15 corruption-consistency
training.hard_negatives: all other tiles from the same 576-board; the explicit term uses the current hardest false candidate
training.mps_nondeterminism: must be explicitly acknowledged; source, corruption and shuffle seeds remain deterministic but MPS indexed backward is not claimed bitwise reproducible

low_d1_discovery_gate.ranking_arm: fullres_twin pooled R@1 delta >= +0.0025 and pooled R@5 delta >= 0 against frozen raw d64
low_d1_discovery_gate.supply_arm: pooled raw-d64/fullres-twin top32 union coverage delta >= +0.01 and matched reciprocal precision delta >= +0.01 at >=3% coverage
